Nick stood up, the edges of his robe having been torn in the crash. He looked up, and saw a giant, gleaming ship. The spotlight was cast right on him. On the side of the ship were the letters: CAMR.

"Shit, they found me" he thought.

He began to run through the twisting maze of what remained of the ship. He could hear footsteps behind him. They were getting closer.

He ran past the remains of a door, and managed to push it closed. He hoped that would slow them down.

He continued down the hallway. Or what remained of it. The ship had been hit by a heat driven missle, so not much had survived.

He continued walking down, the hallways were twisted be the heat of the missle. The walls looked like people screaming to the sky in agony.

Nick wasn't even sure how long the Coalition had been after him. It seemed like years. They had proven a somewhat formidable foe, with their various connections to the media, politicians, and various celebrities. Still, he was over 10 million years old, and had faced worse.

Much worse.

He stopped suddenly. He could hear voices not far from him. He approached a door. It was hanging off its hinges.

He moved to the side of the door. It began to swing open, and two coalitionists, wearing large metal armor walked through.

He had to act fast, past that door was a forest, which led to small town. But there were hundreds of coalitionists on the other side of the wall.

He decided to go for it.

He activated the cloak mode on his armor, and began moving slowly through the small camp they had made. It was full of ships, and armories. He moved past one ship, and hid behind the next. Two coalitionists walked past him.

All Nick had to do was pass two more ships. Unfortunately, his suit was almost out of power. But he had to make it.

So he ran.

Almost immediately, he ran out of power. The coalitionists began to shoot at him instantly. He could see the marks the heat lasers had in the ground, but he had to keep going.

Their were too many to fight, so he ran. The forest ahead led to the small town.

He entered the forest. Slightly injured, but otherwise okay. Now he just needed a ship and he could leave this dead end planet.
